Hi! I just received my order, and I’d like to exchange a couple of items. I want to swap the mechanical keyboard for the same model but with clicky switches, and I also need to exchange the smart thermostat for one that works with Google Home instead of Apple HomeKit. Can you help me with both of these at once?

Yes—I can help with both exchanges in the same order (as long as they’re in the same delivered order), but I first need to authenticate you and then look up your order/items.

1) **Please share your email address** (so I can find your user profile).
2) **Provide your order id** (looks like **#W0000000**) from your confirmation email or packing slip.
3) For each item, please tell me **which ones to exchange**:
   - The **mechanical keyboard**: do you want the same model, just **clicky switches** (any preference on key type/size if you know it)?
   - The **smart thermostat**: do you want **Google Home** compatibility instead of Apple HomeKit.
   
If you can, also paste the **item ids** for the keyboard and thermostat from your order details email/receipt (otherwise I can retrieve them once I pull up the order).

I actually don’t remember my email address, but I do have my order number—it’s #W2378156. 

For the keyboard, I’d like the same model but with clicky switches. If there isn’t a version that’s clicky, full size, and has RGB backlight, I’d be okay with one that’s clicky and full size, even if it doesn’t have backlighting.

For the thermostat, I just need one that works with Google Home instead of Apple HomeKit.

Let me know if you need any more info from me to get started!

Thanks—yes, I can help with both item exchanges for order **#W2378156**.

Before I can access the order and proceed, I need to **authenticate your account** (since you don’t remember your email). Please provide:

1) **First name**  
2) **Last name**  
3) **Zip code**

Once I’ve authenticated you, I’ll pull up **#W2378156** to identify the exact **item IDs** for the mechanical keyboard and smart thermostat, and then we’ll confirm the specific exchange options before I submit anything.
Sure! My first name is Yusuf, last name is Rossi, and my zip code is 19122. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my account.
